# Mana symbols

These unmodified SVG symbols are supplied by Scryfall at
`https://svgs.scryfall.io/card-symbols/{symbol}.svg` and served locally for offline use.
Magic symbols belong to Wizards of the Coast; these assets are not relicensed under
the application's GPL licence. MTG Vault is unofficial and is not endorsed by
Wizards of the Coast or Scryfall. See https://scryfall.com/docs/api/card-symbols.
